title: TransportOrderBillable
description: The TMS decided a Transport-only order is Billable: its Shipment is Delivered, it is Rated and it has a current Proof of delivery, or Customer service released it without one (Canonical Model event, version 1). Published once, on the Transport Order events topic, in the transaction that completed the last condition, under that transaction's correlation ID. The Transport Order's intake correlation ID travels with it. The Billing Logic App hands it to the ERP.

occurredAt.description: When the Transport Order became Billable.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID of the transaction that made the Transport Order Billable: that of the Tracking event, Proof of delivery or re-rate, or a new one for a Customer service action.

intakeCorrelationId.description: The correlation ID of the Transport Order's intake, so it can be traced from intake to its Shipper invoice.

shipperReference.description: The Shipper's own reference for the Transport Order.

deliveryTime.description: When the Shipment was Delivered: the event time of the Delivered Tracking event, with the offset of where it happened.

freightCharge.description: The frozen price Norvia charges the Shipper for the Transport Order, without VAT, as the TransportOrderRated event carried it.

total.description: The sum of the charge lines.

type.description: What the line charges for: always a Freight line, and a Minimum charge adjustment line when the Lane's minimum charge applies.

amount.description: Rounded to cents, half away from zero.

rateCardVersion.description: The version of the Shipper's Rate Card the Freight Charge was calculated from: the one valid on the collection date.

releasedWithoutProofOfDelivery.description: Whether Customer service released the Transport Order without a Proof of delivery.
